items.title: Repatriation of illegal Afghan nationals slows down in Khyber
items.summary: KHYBER: Repatriation of undocumented Afghan nationals has considerably slowed down in recent weeks due to poor living conditions coupled with the impending harsh winter in most parts of Afghanistan, officials say. Sources in Landi Kotal and Torkham told Dawn that 10-15 families were returning to Afghanistan daily, compared to hundreds recorded last September
